international.title: Officials seek dismissal of lawsuit over stabbing of Ukrainian refugee on train in Charlotte
international.summary: Uncle of Iryna Zarutska, a 23-year-old who was murdered on the train, filed a wrongful death lawsuit against the city Officials in Charlotte, North Carolina, have petitioned a judge to dismiss the wrongful death lawsuit over the murder of Iryna Zarutska, a 23-year-old Ukrainian refugee who was killed by a man on a light rail train in the city in August 2025. Zarutska’s uncle, Frank Scott Haskell, who was hosting Zarutska and her family in Charlotte, filed the lawsuit against the city and its transit security company, Professional Security Services, claiming that Charlotte failed to take reasonable and available safety measures to prevent her murder.
